text: Assumption: The callout implementation should not execute any blocking operations — is this correct?
text_en: Assumption: The callout implementation should not execute any blocking operations — is this correct?
norm: the callout implementation should not execute any blocking operations
assumption: The callout implementation should not execute any blocking operations.
rationale: The synchronous forwarding of the return value to the caller requires minimal latency in order not to block the calling context.

original.text: Annahme: Die Callout-Implementierung sollte keine blockierenden Operationen ausführen — trifft das zu?
